text:
emma-cs: Heads-up - Solaris' APAC demo is getting 429s and timed requests. They go live in 3 hours. Asking for a temporary qps bump + IP allowlist so the demo doesn't fail. Renewal convo next week so high priority. :eyes:
ryan-ops: Which endpoints? Any CIDRs?
emma-cs: Mainly /v1/generate and /v1/chat for their interactive demo. IPs they sent: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25. Baseline qps 8 -> peaked ~110 during warmup.
priya-infra: We can grant a short-lived rate_window increase and add the CIDRs to apac-edge allowlist. Need security confirmation and a ticket. Recommend TTL 48h and autorevoke.
theo-eng: FYI their model pin is rwd-7b-highperf, which is CPU-friendly but still sensitive to concurrency. Suggest routing to apac-autoscale pool for demo traffic and enable KV prefix cache to cut token latency.
nina-sales: Please avoid open-ended increases. Sales asks for explicit windows and an automatic rollback. Also capture demo feedback for renewal notes.
emma-cs: Solaris wants a 48h window starting now, demo at 2024-12-02T09:00Z. They'll accept 48h auto-revoke. I've attached their IP ownership PDF to the support ticket draft.
ryan-ops: Opening ticket INFRA-8533. Plan: - add CIDRs to allowlist (apac-edge-peers) - set rate_window for customer_id=solariscorp to 120 qps - route demo traffic to apac-autoscale pool with canary 5% for 20m - schedule autorevoke at +172800s
ryan-ops: Sample patch (pushed as comment to INFRA-8533):
```json
{"customer_id":"solariscorp","route":"apac-primary","rate_limit_qps":120,"allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.128/25"],"ttl_seconds":172800}
```
priya-infra: Tagging @ops-bot and @theo-eng. Need quick sec thumbs-up for CIDRs.
ops-bot: Audit log created: ticket=INFRA-8533, actor=ryan-ops, change=allowlist+rate_window+routing, ttl=172800s.
priya-infra: Security confirmed ownership doc matches CIDRs. Moving to staging then prod. ETA ~15m.
theo-eng: I'll enable a 5% canary to apac-autoscale and monitor p95 latency and kv cache hit-rate. If p95 >700ms or error_rate>1.5% during canary, we'll rollback.
ryan-ops: Canary started (5%). Monitoring dashboards up.
ops-bot: Canary report: error_rate=1.1%, p95_latency=610ms, kv_cache_hit=48%.
theo-eng: Canary looks acceptable. Ramping to 100% over 6m.
ryan-ops: Ramped to 100%. Temp rate_window active. Autorevoke scheduled in 48h. Manual rollback instructions added to INFRA-8533.
emma-cs: Solaris confirms demo completed successfully and sent positive note on responsiveness. I'll capture any prompt examples they want us to add to evals. Passing to Nina for renewal follow-up. :tada:
nina-sales: Thanks Emma. I'll include this win in the renewal deck and note the last-minute ops assist.
ops-bot: Action complete: allowlist+rate_window applied to solariscorp, ttl=172800s. Logged by ryan-ops."
